maria (growth): quick idea 60 	6 we pick 3 compact charts for the benchmark hero and run a micro A/B on CTAs. owners?
tejas (marketing): yes, limit creative to a single hero row + one mobile-friendly chart. 3 charts max.
olivia (design): proposed comps: 1) p50/p95 sparkline vs token length, 2) cost-per-1k stacked bars (hosted vs dedicated vs quantized), 3) throughput heatmap. i'll mock tonight.
samir (pm): data: use v2-opt perf runs + cold/warm KV profiles. i'll export CSVs to /bench/2026-03/mini-summary.csv and include a cold/warm column.
maria (growth): CTA variants: "Start free" (trial funnel) vs "See savings" (book demo). we'll route high-usage prospects to AEs.
nina (content): short hero options: 1) "Predictable LLM inference: fast p50s, clear unit economics." 2) "Lower per-token costs without sacrificing latency." social captions 2x ready by EOD.
tejas (marketing): numbers check: p50 ~80ms hosted; cost hosted ~$0.02/1k, dedicated ~$0.006/1k in quantized configs. ok to say "up to 3x" with qualifier.
olivia (design): we'll avoid exact multipliers in hero. use splash text "significantly lower unit cost on dedicated configs" then footnote.
samir (pm): heatmap sample (placeholder):
```
seq_len,batch,throughput
64,16,420
64,64,1500
512,16,95
512,64,380
```
use those cells for layout.
maria (growth): routing rules: trial signups >100k tokens/month OR est spend >$2000 -> AE handoff. nina, capture in launch doc.
nina (content): will do. A/B test plan: run 2-week experiment, measure CTR, signup conversion, token volume, demo requests. capture segments.
tejas (marketing): timeline: design mock Thu, copy Fri, internal review Mon, experiment start next Wed. owners: olivia design, nina copy, samir data, tejas analytics, maria launch.
maria (growth): one more: include a micro testimonial blurb from an early dedicated customer if legal clears it. helps credibility.
olivia (design): noted. i'll add a small customer quote slot in the hero layout.
maria (growth): thanks all. i'll book a 20min sign-off on Mon. :calendar: :rocket:
